windows_macos_host_ram_gap.label: REAL
windows_macos_host_ram_gap.prior_state: membrane_read_host_meminfo() (tools/membrane-run/runtime_session.cpp) was Linux-only (/proc/meminfo) -- --ctx auto correctly, safely failed closed (PLANNER_REJECTED_ALL/NO_FEASIBLE_CONTEXT) on Windows and macOS rather than guessing, but never actually sized context on either platform.
windows_macos_host_ram_gap.fix_this_phase: added a real Windows branch (GlobalMemoryStatusEx() -- the identical, already-vendored, already-CI-building pattern this project's own llama.cpp submodule uses in ggml-cpu.cpp's own CPU-device memory query) and a real macOS branch (sysctlbyname("hw.memsize") for total, host_statistics64(HOST_VM_INFO64) free+inactive pages for a genuine 'available' estimate -- the same definition vm_stat/Activity Monitor use, not a crude total-as-free approximation). Swap left at 0/unknown on both (honest, since it is diagnostic-only everywhere in this project and never gates a decision -- matching this function's own existing Linux-kernel-without-swap precedent).
windows_macos_host_ram_gap.validation_plan: real GitHub-hosted windows-latest / macos-14 runners (genuine hardware, not emulation) -- macos-metal-smoke and windows-support-smoke CI jobs updated to exercise real --ctx auto (dropping their prior --ctx N workaround) so this is proven on real hardware, not just compiled.
windows_macos_host_ram_gap.validation_result: CONFIRMED -- real windows-latest/macos-14 CI runs on this PR both PASS with a real --ctx auto generation step (no --ctx N workaround), gated by a hard, non-continue-on-error exit-code check. macos-metal-smoke: pass (5m52s/6m46s across two runs). windows-support-smoke: pass (6m57s/7m42s). docs/macos-metal.md and docs/windows-support.md updated accordingly.
